_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description (all four of these currently have none set). Setting them on GitHub too is worth doing - it helps anyone browsing your repo list.

projects.description: A next.js web application that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams. This app allows you to create, modify, and enhance diagrams through natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization.
A smart water management system that enables real-time usage monitoring, AI-based consumption forecasting, leak detection, and transparent token-based billing for residential communities.
An AI-powered healthcare chatbot that provides an interactive conversational experience for health-related queries.
An AI-powered resume application that helps users analyze, improve, and optimize their resumes using intelligent feedback.
